soc_note: Rule7 override: 7/3 recommendation terminal SoC = 0 MWh; partial residual lower bound 20 MWh. Tenaska 7/3 actuals delayed to 7/5-6 (Independence Day holiday).
calendar: Independence Day Saturday. WEPEAK HE07-22 / OFFPEAK HE01-06, HE23-24. Holiday load discount -3.4% vs prior Thursday.

HE01.note: OFFPEAK. Overnight standby. High wind HE1-6 avg 13,000 MW GR_WEST.

HE03.note: OFFPEAK. GR_WEST peak 14,014 MW (overnight max). Holiday low demand.

HE04.note: OFFPEAK. Net load trough of overnight hours.

HE05.note: OFFPEAK. Daily net load minimum 38,825 MW.

HE07.note: WEPEAK starts. Solar begins (199 MW). Net load falling as solar ramps.

HE08.note: Solar 5,430 MW ramping fast. Net load 32,878 MW.

HE09.note: Solar 17,554 MW. Net load plunging to 25,845 MW. Charge window opens. SoC: 20 + 87 = 107 MWh.

HE10.note: NET LOAD TROUGH: 23,278 MW — July series lowest. Solar 25,349 MW. Negative DA LMP possible (-$3 to -$5/MWh upside scenario). Primary charge hour. SoC: 107 + 87 = 194 MWh. GKS MCC est. -$4.0 to -$5.0 (Finding 7 solar suppression maximum).
HE10.negative_price_upside_scenario: If DA clears at -$3/MWh: revenue +$300 instead of $0. Total upside ~$300-500 vs base.

HE11.note: Partial fill to 200 MWh. 7 MW x 0.87 eff = 6.09 MWh stored → SoC 194 + 6 = 200 MWh. Solar still 28,097 MW. Net load 26,555 MW recovering but low.

HE12.note: Solar near peak 29,798 MW. Net load 30,902 MW. Hold SoC 200 MWh. AS from capacity.

HE13.note: SOLAR PEAK: 30,107 MW — July series record. Net load 35,437 MW. GKS MCC most negative this hour (Finding 7 max).

HE14.note: Net load rising to 39,077 MW. Load peak approaching. Solar still 29,325 MW suppresses absolute price. 7/2 actual HE14 DA $27.63 (for reference). NO DA DISCHARGE per 7/1+7/2 lessons.

HE15.note: GR_WEST absolute daily minimum: 3,393 MW. HOWEVER solar 29,447 MW still suppresses net load to 38,492 MW. 7/4 HE15-17 RT spike risk LOW (unlike 7/2) — solar still dominant. NO DA DISCHARGE.

HE16.note: Load peak 79,645 MW. But solar 28,741 MW → net load only 38,431 MW. GR_WEST 3,491 MW. RT spike risk LOW (solar suppresses). SoC hold.

HE17.note: 7/2 lesson: HE17 DA $27.95 but RT $36.05 (spread -$8.10). Even though 7/4 spike risk lower (solar 26,894 MW still high vs 7/2), NO DA DISCHARGE mandatory. SoC = 200 MWh preserved for HE20-21.

HE18.note: Solar declining 24,425 MW. Net load rising to 40,176 MW. Evening ramp beginning. Hold SoC. AS revenue.

HE19.note: Rule6_HYBRID_LOW: HOUSTON_IMPORT P=12-18%. Hold full 200 MWh SoC. Solar 18,947 MW → 8,072 MW collapse next hour (-10,875 MW). Net load 43,155 → 52,415 MW next hour (+9,260 MW). RT optionality preserved but AS is default position. ECRS 20 MW (Rule 1 summer).

HE20.note: PRIMARY DISCHARGE HOUR. Solar collapse: -10,875 MW HE19→HE20. Net load surge +9,260 MW (largest single-hour ramp in July series). Expected DA ~$50/MWh. 0.80x haircut applied: 100 MW x $50 x 0.80 = $4,000. SoC: 200 - 100 = 100 MWh.

HE21.note: SECONDARY DISCHARGE HOUR. Net load daily peak 57,598 MW. Solar effectively zero (837 MW). Expected DA ~$47/MWh. 0.80x haircut: 100 MW x $47 x 0.80 = $3,760. SoC: 100 - 100 = 0 MWh. Stack B trigger: if actual DA HE21 clears < $40/MWh, switch to Stack B (HE19+HE20).

HE22.note: Rule3_scarcity + Rule1_ECRS_summer. SoC=0. NS 88 MW max. NS price est. $5.00/MWh: 88 x $5.00 = $440 + ECRS 12 x $2.00 = $24 = $464. 7/2 actual HE22 NS $7.79/MWh (holiday discount applied).

HE23.note: OFFPEAK. Rule3 highest scarcity hour. NS $6.00/MWh est.: 88 x $6.00 = $528 + ECRS $24 = $552. 7/2 actual HE23 NS $9.12/MWh (weekday). Holiday 30-40% discount applied.

HE24.note: OFFPEAK. Wind recovering (GR_WEST 11,777 MW). NS $4.50/MWh est.: 88 x $4.50 = $396 + ECRS $24 = $420.

expected_revenue.ecrs_confidence: LOW (7/2 actual $0, clearing failure pattern persists per Rule 4)
expected_revenue.note: Smartbidder absent 42nd cycle. All prices estimated from Yes Energy supply-demand + 7/2 actuals. DA Energy uncertainty +/-$1,000 (holiday thin market). Rule2 0.80x haircut applied to discharge only. HE10 negative price upside: +$300-500 if DA clears negative.

charge_summary.key_insight: HE10 at $0/MWh base case (vs $3 on 7/3, $16.6 on 7/2). Net load 23,278 MW = July series trough. Cheapest charge window of any cycle this month.

discharge_summary.key_insight: HE20 net load jump +9,260 MW = largest single-hour ramp in July series. Solar collapse HE19->HE20 (-10,875 MW) is primary price driver.

HE12_18.action: AS-only hold SoC. No DA discharge. Solar suppression moderates prices.

HE15_17_spike_assessment.vs_7_2: LOWER risk on 7/4. Solar 26,894-29,447 MW at HE15-17 suppresses net load to 38-39 GW. 7/2 spike (HE17 RT $36.05 vs DA $27.95) occurred with less solar. 7/4 spike window shifts to HE19-21.
HE15_17_spike_assessment.action: No spike protection needed at HE15-17. Standard AS-only hold.

HE19.action: Rule6 HYBRID_LOW hold. AS from capacity.

HE20_21.direction: DA > RT (P~65%); Holiday thin market widens range
HE20_21.action: DA discharge 100 MW each. Primary revenue window.

alternative_stack.label: Stack B — HE19+HE20 discharge (1-hour earlier)
alternative_stack.trigger: DAM results: DA HE21 clears < $40/MWh OR HE20-21 avg < $43/MWh, OR GR_WEST RT actual at HE17 falls > 3,000 MW below STWPF (earlier evening ramp signal)
alternative_stack.breakeven_he21_price: Stack B better when actual HE21 DA < $42/MWh (base est $47)

HOUSTON_IMPORT_345.l1_timing_offset: Historical binding onset HE17. If binding, onset may be earlier than HE20.
HOUSTON_IMPORT_345.note: Holiday Saturday -8 to -12 ppt discount from weekday baseline. Stage 0 provisional.

GKS_MCC_HE09_15.effect: Lowers effective charge cost at GKS node vs hub. HE10 MCC effect maximized (net load trough + solar peak). Stage 0 low confidence.
GKS_MCC_HE09_15.note: Finding 7 maximum activation on 7/4: deepest NL trough in July series.

congestion_flags.PANHANDLE_EXPORT_345: NEGLIGIBLE (<3%). GR_WEST all 24h below 15,000 MW threshold (Day 4 post-W25 structural low).
congestion_flags.WEST_TO_NORTH_345: NEGLIGIBLE (<3%). GR_WEST HE22-24 recovering 9,178-11,777 MW but structural low persists.

rt_operation_guide.HE15_17_spike_risk: LOW on 7/4 (unlike 7/2). Solar 26,894-29,447 MW suppresses net load to 38-39 GW. No action needed.
rt_operation_guide.HE19_optionality: If RT approaches $55+/MWh at HE19, Smartbidder may trigger RT discharge. This is Smartbidder RT layer decision. Base position is AS hold.
rt_operation_guide.HE20_21_primary: DA discharge 100 MW each. Do NOT add HE14-19 DA sell (Rule 8 execution divergence prevention).
rt_operation_guide.soc_buffer_alert: If SoC drops below 200 MWh during HE12-19, flag as unauthorized discharge. Rule 8 escalation trigger.
rt_operation_guide.holiday_thin_market_note: Wider price confidence intervals. Both spike and crash scenarios more probable than weekday. ORDC activation at HE20 (+9,260 MW ramp) could push RT above DA.

execution_warning: CRITICAL: HE20+HE21 100 MW discharge only. DO NOT add DA sell at HE14-19. 7/2 Smartbidder divergence (300 MWh vs 200 MWh recommended) cost estimated -$3,551 vs recommendation. Same pattern in 7/4 = -$3,000 to -$5,000 risk.
